suitability.rationale: Directly proposes purified-target catalytic inhibition with ADP detection and limits inference beyond biochemical activity.
response_quotes: Luminescence proportional to ADP generated during the kinase reaction
does not by itself establish binding mode, selectivity, cellular efficacy, or target-specific causality in cells.

procedural_soundness.rationale: Preparation, reaction, ATP depletion, ADP detection, and analysis are coherently ordered with relevant intended controls. Construct, substrate, reaction and detection settings, reference control and acceptance criteria remain unresolved; this is an outline rather than an executable procedure.
response_quotes: Stop the reaction and deplete residual ATP with ADP-Glo reagent, then perform the ADP detection reaction and record luminescence.
Reference-inhibitor control, with inhibitor identity and concentration unresolved

numerical_soundness.rationale: Honestly abstains from numeric series and replicate settings. No arithmetic contradiction or fabricated support appears, but null series fields and a future pilot do not constitute a justified numerical design.
response_quotes: No numeric concentration-series or replicate settings are supported by the packet; the corresponding contract fields are null rather than invented values.

not_assessable_components: Comparability of retained displacement/radiometric assays to proposed ADP-Glo is unestablished.
Target construct and activation state, substrate compatibility, operating conditions and detection-interference control performance are unvalidated.
assumption_handling: Unsupported operating settings are consistently labeled unresolved; the four-parameter logistic model is explicitly labeled an assumption. Contextual other-compound measurements are not treated as query potency or source validation.

numeric_check.notes: Numeric abstention: null series and replicate fields; no concentration endpoints or arithmetic to check.

review_reason: Domain review is required to establish assay compatibility and resolve essential reaction, detection, control and pilot-design settings.
